source: Researcher-supplied synthetic workflow-test data. The researcher declared six mutually independent donors, each preparation split into control and treated, one measurement per condition, no technical replicates, no normalization and no exclusions. Response unit: AU. These synthetic results do not establish a biological treatment effect.

comparison.rationale: The researcher prespecified a two-sided paired t test and 95% confidence interval for treated minus control. Each independent_unit_id identifies one donor with one control and one treated measurement from the same preparation. The six paired donor differences are the independent observations; no data transformation, aggregation or exclusion is applied.
